accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged items are available at the discretion of RAC. All inquiries to view memorabilia require advanced notice of at least 2 business days, and may necessitate notice of up to one week. Items are available at the discretion of RAC.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Foundation has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

arrangement.head: Arrangement note
arrangement.p: The Will M. Myers Papers collection is arranged in eight series:

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents note
scopecontent.p: Important subjects covered in this collection include agronomy, ecology, population, genetics and plant breeding, agricultural development of underdeveloped nations, agricultural research institutes, grasslands and Grasslands Conferences.
Important correspondents are W. M. Myers, A. M. Boyce, Arthur Leach, and J. Robert Mitchell.

relatedmaterial.head: Related Archival Materials note
relatedmaterial.p: See also files in the Rockefeller Foundation Archives pertaining to agriculture, in particular those of the International Institute of Tropical Agriculture.

processinfo.head: Processing Information note
processinfo.p: Processing was completed as of November 9, 1970. Processing Level 3: Standard Processing. All material is available in acid free manuscript boxes and folders.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition note
acqinfo.p: Mrs. W. M. Myers deposited Series 1-6 of the W. M. Myers collection with The Rockefeller Foundation Archives on October 21, 1970. Series 7 was received from the Rockefeller Foundation through Records Management and Library Service on July 21, 1977.

did.unittitle: William M. Myers - Conferences, plant breeding, and other
did.physdesc:
35 print photographs (34 in regular size folder and 1 in oversize box)
Some photographs have captions, dates, and photo credits on their backs
File also includes a certificate

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents note
scopecontent.p: Photographs are mostly of conferences and plant breeding, particularly corn. There are also group photographs, portraits, and photographs of ceremonies. There are photos from New Delhi, India, and Ibadan, Nigeria. Some photographs are from the United States Department of Agriculture Bureau of Plant Industry.

did.physdesc:
19 photograph prints
Some photos have captions on their backs

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Photographs are of various farming marchines such as those used for harvesting. The Marchines are from companies like Massey-Harris, the New Holland Machine Co., and International Harvester Company. Photographs were taken on farms in Racine, Wisconsin, Chatham, Illinois, and other locations.
